prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, and 9 were underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.6% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +2.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_split_layout_redesign: Redesign the choose path screen using a split layout to clearly compare pet adoption paths side-by-side. (why: Choose path step has a 23.8% drop-off rate and a high mean time of 514s, indicating confusion during choice selection.)
1: [home, new_screen] waiting_pet_care_tips_screen: Insert a new screen before waiting that introduces desktop pet interaction basics while the pet is generating. (why: Home waiting step has a median time of 201s (mean 2336s) and drop-off of 18.7%, plus support emails show post-onboarding interaction confusion.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] sign_in_split_account_restoration_redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen to a split layout focusing on account restoration to prevent pet loss. (why: Support mail logged 8 complaints about missing/reset pets after re-signing in, and sign-in drop-off is 27.1%.)
3: [home, wait_info] waiting_time_estimate_and_notify: Display explicit completion time estimates and turn on background notifications when pet generation completes. (why: The waiting stage takes a mean of 2336s, leading to 18.7% abandon rate during generation.)
4: [adoption, layout] pick_friend_grid_layout: Switch the pick friend screen to a grid layout for better side-by-side comparison of pet options. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9%. Grid layout enables faster visual comparison of starter pets.)
5: [choose_path, incentive] story_intro_welcome_banner: Add a cheerful mascot welcome message and clear headline to the opening story screen. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path before starting adoption.)
6: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_interaction_copy: Update the home intro text with clear guidance on how to locate the pet on desktop and right-click to open pet controls. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not appearing on desktop and 3 complained about unclear pet controls.)
7: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_guidance_hint: Provide clear photo selection tips and delayed guidance timing on the upload photos screen. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or malformed pets during adoption.)
